summary: Sporting News roundup of new-user promo codes from six sportsbooks (Caesars, BetMGM, Bet365, FanDuel, DraftKings, BetRivers) for college basketball, centered on the ACC-SEC Challenge including Tennessee vs. North Carolina and Duke vs. Arkansas. It lists each offer, its code, and terms such as deposit minimums, state exclusions and playthrough requirements. It ends with a brief lean toward North Carolina or the OVER.
one_line: Guide to new-user sportsbook promo codes worth $5,000+ for college basketball's ACC-SEC Challenge games, with offer terms and a UNC lean.
key_facts: Caesars Sportsbook promo code NEWS1000 gives a First Bet up to $1,000; if the first bet loses, Caesars credits bonus bets equal to the wager up to $1,000.
BetMGM bonus code TSN50 offers a First Bet bonus up to $1,500 plus a $50 bonus bet in select states, requiring a minimum $10 deposit.
The extra $50 BetMGM bonus bet is unavailable in Washington D.C., Kentucky, Mississippi, Nevada, New York, Puerto Rico and Ontario, where users can use code SPORTSPICK for the $1,500 First Bet offer.
Bet365 bonus code TSNCO offers a choice of First Bet Safety Net up to $1,000 or Bet $5, Get $150 in bonus bets; Virginia uses code VATSN and New Jersey uses NJTSN.
FanDuel's offer is Bet $5 on any moneyline and get $150 in bonus bets if your team wins, with no odds restrictions.
DraftKings offers up to $1,200 in welcome offers: a 20% deposit match up to $1,000, a $50 Bonus Bet with a $5 deposit, and Bet $5, Get $150 in Bonus Bets.
Maxing out the DraftKings deposit match at $1,000 requires a minimum $5,000 deposit and meeting a 25X playthrough requirement.
DraftKings signup requires personal info including name, email, last four of SSN, and mailing address; all customers also get a daily 'No Sweat SGP'.
BetRivers promo code SPORTSRIV provides a 2nd chance bet up to $500 depending on state, refunded in bonus bets if the first bet loses.
The ACC-SEC Challenge slate that day had seven games, starting with No. 7 Tennessee vs. No. 14 North Carolina, plus Duke vs. Arkansas.
North Carolina lost to Villanova in OT and beat Arkansas in the Battle4Atlantis in the Bahamas the previous week.
The author suggests betting on the home team (North Carolina) or the OVER, citing UNC's fast-paced offense.
